notes: And afterwards is read as two morphemes' two words under rule 14's closing paragraph: אַחַר takes afterwards and the waw takes And, whatever the English order.
בַּחוּץ fuses as the single adverb without under rules 30 and 40, the separately segmented article being excluded and marked unrepresented as rule 30 does for דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים.
